title: Malicious code in @sxm-content-creators/tools-ds (npm)
description: The npm package '@sxm-content-creators/tools-ds' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, uncompromised device. Removing the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by it, as full control of the computer may have been granted to an attacker.
